name: Celo Transaction Trace
description: A browser-based Celo receipt decoder with a separate x402-protected receipt lookup API currently deployed on Celo Sepolia only. The web tool decodes pasted receipt JSON locally; the API returns receipt metadata and ERC-20 Transfer logs for a supplied Celo Sepolia transaction hash. No Celo mainnet API or autonomous transaction sender is implemented.

services.name: x402
services.description: POST /decode; x402 payment required at 0.01 Celo Sepolia USDC per request; returns decoded Celo Sepolia receipt JSON.
